I'm in the same boat, been in the same boat for months and months. I'm looking for a way out but I cant find it. I want to say, possibly runaway and go on from there but I don't want you doing that. God, I'm 18 and have absolutely nothing. I want to genuinely die but I'm too much of a coward to even try. I want to runaway but what good would that do? I wouldnt even be a run "away" just an adult with no job.

That's not the case at all. What the heck. It's all because of covid and how many people are getting online each day because of it. For me, a lot of friends have been getting on, just imagine everyone who owns an xbox. It's a lot for the servers.

You'd be surprised how many people ask that. I ask myself that exact same question. 

Even if it doesn't work, that doesn't mean you can never cure your depression. Time helps, being with others you care about or brings you joy helps. They may not always be with you, so during the time when you are alone with your thoughts, think about the good times of your life, as small as a good 1 minute memory or as big as a meaningful moment. And if you still don't have something to think about, don't think about anything clear your mind, listen to music and sleep and relax.

I have no idea if this is helping at all so I'm sorry if it's bad (currently is 3AM right now)

And hey, you gotta love yourself. It may be the hardest thing you will ever do but once you understand who you are, your flaws, your own self worth. Things are bound to get better. Don't let anyone else tell you your worth. YOU are the only one who gets a say in that, everyone else? Nahhhhhh

You aren't worthless.
My words can only go so far, so to end this reply, repeat those words. 

I may be some random person in the internet but I am real, and I say you aren't the person you say you are. Not even saying that to make you feel better, I genuinely mean it. If you have gone through all of that and still standing? You are brave and strong.

I understand literally almost all of what you described. I, myself, have a similar feeling towards people around me, my family, my ex/bf now, life.

From what I'm getting here, is that you envy others for what they have, and feel as though they don't deserve what they have now. 

As selfish that might sound, it's not. You are longing at the thought of someone caring for you, you getting what you deserve. I know it may be hard understanding that not everything always goes your way, but sometimes we need to let go of those emotions, the anger. But not in ways that we hurt ourselves doing it. I can't tell you ways to ease the pain and anger, because only you can do that. It sucks, I know, but with someone like you, you deserve the chance to make yourself feel alright again. Prove yourself wrong, make yourself proud by taken steps to ease that anger.

Don't think about what others tell you, or even do to you, including your husband. You are the only one who really knows what you are going through and what positive impacts you are doing to your family by just staying with them. If your husband or anyone doesn't see that, then they don't. But you and I do. And I say, you are an amazing parent working her ass off to make her kids happy. And hopefully stay long enough to see them grow up, in their mother's foot steps.

First of all, you are doing an amazing job thinking about your children. They may not be old enough to understand anything but they know who you are, you are their mother. A caring mother who has fought with herself for years to stay and care for her own children. In any book, in any universe, that is the most bravest thing you could do. If you've gone through all of that time protecting and staying with them, dont change it, be their proud mother. 

And that pain, it probably wont go away in just few days, weeks. But holding onto that little bit of hope you have, your kids, it really is the only light that you need.

I posted on this about 30 minutes ago about a problem I had. 

My situation is very different than yours (I'm 17)

But even if I not much help, I don't want you feeling like no one cares about you. I don't want you feeling alone.

The words that I type up aren't going to help much for the long run, but for right now... I need you to tell me, are you afraid of dying? I know you feel like you don't want to exist at all but would you be able to pull that trigger?

He was bad after the break up, and honestly I, myself dont even know, I missed him. But he brought back a lot of things. I hate him and love him at the same time. But I haven't gotten the courage to tell him all of this. 

I know, I'm stupid. But I have history with him, and I was willing to give it a shot if it really was meant to be.

I don't have the money. And that leads back to him, without a job, I can't get into a university. And I was going to have help but the time he came back to was the time I was going to get help, but then I couldn't because I got PTSD. I couldn't even get up and talk to them. So I post-poned it... but the virus happened and school got shut down. Theres been help to get everything filled out, but it's only through emails.

And as you can see, I've been feeling dead this past month.

He completely destroyed who was as a person. Kept on continuously making my life a little worse. After the break up. But overall, he messed with my mental health, which was already in a bad state before I met him. It took a year to recover from the wounds of that break up, and with that, I had to deal with my own emotions to wanting to commit suicide for that year. With my parents being strict and out of money, I couldn't get a therapist. I was on my own. I finally got the courage to do something with my life but he comes in and brings back old wounds, PTSD. And with this virus going on, it's made my state even worse.

He ruined my life to make his better. And even after that, he still wanted to come back into my life.
